```{r}
steam_api_key <- Sys.getenv("6431787D94B64F0CB998C43BA9E66C54")
"6431787D94B64F0CB998C43BA9E66C54" #API Key
steam_id <- "76561199875296546" #Steam id

response <- GET(
  "https://api.steampowered.com/IPlayerService/GetOwnedGames/v1/",
  query = list(
    key = steam_api_key,
    steamids = steam_id,
    include_appinfo = 1,
    format = "json"
  )
)
stop_for_status(response)
response

json_text <- content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")

json_text

raw_data <- fromJSON(json_text, flatten = TRUE)

# List of Games to grab
appids <- c(730, 570, 440)

# Finds the current number of players in the games listed in appids
get_player_count <- function(appid) {
  r <- GET(
    "https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamUserStats/GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers/v1/",
    query = list(appid = appid)
  )
  stop_for_status(r)
  fromJSON(content(r, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))$response$player_count
}

counts <- tibble(appid = appids) |>
  mutate(players = sapply(appid, function(id) {
    Sys.sleep(1)
    get_player_count(id)
  }))

get_global_stats <- function(appid) {
  r <- GET(
    "https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamUserStats/GetGlobalStatsForGame/v1/",
    query = list(appid = appid)
  )
  stop_for_status(r)
  fromJSON(content(r, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))$response$global_stat
}

```
